purpose: separate story quotations from in-universe Statement claims and combat Evidence; no automatic scoring

processStages.meaning: 사실 후보로 접수; 원문을 아직 확인하지 않았을 수 있음
합법적으로 접근 가능한 원작에서 정확한 한국어 표현·화자·회차·시점 검토
문구 분량·사용 목적·권리자 조건 등 인용 적정성을 별도 검토
위 조건을 모두 충족하고 별도 공개 승인

controls.independentSourceRule: wiki, social posts and recollection cannot establish exact dialogue without original work verification
controls.duplicateRule: same utterance repeated by fan pages counted once
controls.absentRecordRule: empty candidate array is valid and creates no placeholder quotes in UI
controls.publishRule: exact source, attribution, scene context, user's approval and lawful quotation decision must all be satisfied
controls.statementRule: a narrative quote may also be a Statement candidate but is never treated as proof of its factual truth
controls.copyrightRule: private review notes not a publication license; no unlicensed comic panels, screenshots or long excerpts
controls.localization: prefer checked Korean original rather than translated fan text
controls.access: do not bypass paid-content authentication or circumvent protected screenshots
controls.textCap: do not mechanically assume any fixed character count guarantees fair use or lawful quotation

plannedStages.v3_2: data contract and discovery questions only; old registry untouched
plannedStages.v3_3: collect candidate leads and verify exact text/episodes with user
plannedStages.v3_4: optional guarded quote display in character profile after approval and rights review
